description: Allow Workflow tasks to execute a project Agent through a durable server-resolved runtime Action snapshot, keeping the finalized task-only contract and the existing runtime Action input contracts unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the virtual Agent Action contract for tasks
tasks.description: Add the server-owned `mohist/agent` manifest with closed static `name`, template-renderable `prompt`, optional `session`, and optional `timeout` inputs to profile catalog validation. Accept it for tasks and reject it for checks without querying current Agent state during profile save.
acceptanceCriteria: Profiles accept valid mohist/agent tasks before the referenced Agent exists
Profiles reject mohist/agent when used for a check
Missing name or prompt and unknown inputs fail profile validation for tasks
Template prompt values remain valid at profile-save time
Template name values fail profile validation for tasks
tasks.output: Server virtual Action manifest and profile validation specs
tasks.notes: The Runner must not register mohist/agent. Checks are unsupported, not silently ignored.

tasks.title: Resolve Agent references, compose instructions, and persist task dispatch snapshots
tasks.description: Extract an active-only name-or-id Agent execution snapshot resolver using the command-surface order: agent_* references are id-only; all others are name-first with an id fallback. In the translator, compose the resolved Agent instructions ahead of the task's raw (unrendered) prompt into a single dispatch prompt, map the result to the existing OpenCode/Pi input contract, and extend Workflow active-work state and grain commands to compare-and-store the complete transformed WorkDispatch. Transform task uses before storage; poll redelivery reads the stored envelope and retry resolves again.
acceptanceCriteria: Task dispatches resolve an active Agent and produce a concrete mohist/opencode or mohist/pi envelope whose prompt is the Agent instructions followed by the raw task prompt, with the raw prompt retained as the workflow goal
The transformed envelope's options contains at most model and variant; no instructions key is emitted to the Runner
Template expressions in the raw task prompt are still rendered by the Runner, not by the server
After Agent edit plus server restart or grain activation, redelivery returns the original stored envelope
A task retry resolves the current Agent definition into a new snapshot
No Agent entity, AgentJob, or direct AgentSession lifecycle enters Workflow
A non-prefixed legacy id that collides with an Agent name resolves to the name match
tasks.output: Agent execution snapshot resolver, server-side prompt composition, durable Workflow active-work dispatch snapshot, translator and poll reconciliation specs
tasks.notes: Store the full wire envelope, not only Agent identity or config. Composition is on the raw prompt only.

tasks.title: Preserve structured Agent resolution failures in Workflow task reports
tasks.description: Make dispatch rejection carry ExecutionError through DispatchService and IWorkflowGrain. A failed task dispatch stores agent_not_found on TaskRun, then uses normal Workflow recovery and advancement decisions. Do not alter the runtime Action contracts; resolution failure is reported before any Runner invocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing or archived task Agent produces TaskRun.Error.code equal to agent_not_found and recovery can match failure.error.code
The failure path offers no Runner work and creates no AgentSession or AgentJob
The published input contracts and existing unknown-options-key behavior of mohist/opencode and mohist/pi are unchanged
tasks.output: Structured Workflow dispatch rejection path with task specs
tasks.notes: Workflow remains the decision maker; this task only preserves Runner-independent facts.

tasks.title: Verify the complete Workflow-owned Agent Action behavior
tasks.description: Add focused server coverage for task transformation, server-side instruction composition against the raw prompt, snapshot redelivery and retry, structured resolution failures, Workflow-origin session addressing, check rejection at profile validation, and unchanged inline Action behavior. Run the affected server typecheck/test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Specs cover both OpenCode and Pi task paths and prove the transformed envelope stays within each runtime Action's published input contract
Specs prove no AgentJob is created and named Workflow sessions retain their existing namespace
Specs prove mohist/agent is rejected for checks at profile validation
npm test passes for the affected server suites without real runtime, network, filesystem, or wall-clock dependencies
tasks.output: Focused server regression coverage and passing verification commands
tasks.notes: No runner changes exist in this plan; existing runner tests guard the unchanged runtime Actions. Use injected time only.

tasks.title: Reconcile the Agent Action product contract with the implementation
tasks.description: Confirm docs/actions/agent.md already describes mohist/agent as task-only with static name, template-renderable prompt, the canonical agent_* id-only / name-first id-fallback resolver order, and the agent_not_found failure. Apply only the minimal wording needed so the documented contract matches this implementation; do not expand scope to checks.
acceptanceCriteria: The product documentation describes task-only usage consistent with the implemented Action contract
The product documentation states that template expressions are accepted only for prompt and rejected for name
The product documentation states the exact name-or-id resolver precedence and the agent_not_found failure
tasks.output: Confirmed or minimally updated docs/actions/agent.md product contract
tasks.notes: The contract is already task-only; this task is reconciliation, not expansion.
